answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a jade bet on surviving 45 epochs of grading, and every nectar settlement recomputes the jetty schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 45 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 23 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
